caveats: Requires Paseo 0.14.0-beta.1 or newer on both the daemon and the app.
Agents get its tools only while Paseo injects its own tools into agents (daemon.mcp.injectIntoAgents).
The card, the form and the settings screen are in Ukrainian only.
A delivered value sits for minutes in a file the daemon's OS user can read; the agent not reading it is discipline, not a lock.
